tha-ap60:1.1: Dhajadāyaka.] Padumuttarabuddhassa bodhiyā pādamuttame / h*aṭṭho haṭṭhena ci*ttena dhajjam āropayiṃ ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap60:2.1: Patapattāni gaṇhitvā bahiddhā chaḍḍayiṃ ahaṃ / anto suddhaṃ bahi suddhaṃ adhimuttam anāsavaṃ /
tha-ap60:3.1: sammukhā viya sambuddhaṃ avandiṃ bodhim uttamaṃ. // // Padumuttaro lokavidū *āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho* /
tha-ap60:4.1: bhikkhusaṅghe ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // // ‘Iminā dhajadānena upaṭṭhānena cūbhayaṃ /
tha-ap60:5.1: kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ so na gacchati / devesu devasobhāgyaṃ anubhossat' a*nappakaṃ.* // //
tha-ap60:6.1: Anekasatakkhattuñ ca rājā raṭṭhe bhavissati / Uggato nāma nāmena cakkavattī bhavissati. // //
tha-ap60:7.1: Sampattiṃ anubhotvāna sukkamūlena codito / Gotamassa bhagavato sāsane 'bhiramissati.' // //
tha-ap60:8.1: Pa*dhānaṃ pahita*tto 'mhi upasanto nirūpadhi / dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane. // //
tha-ap60:9.1: Ekapaññāsasahasse kappe Uggatasavhayo / paññāsasatasahasse khattiyo Meghasavhayo. // //
tha-ap60:10.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ
tha-ap60:11.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Dhajadāyako thero ima gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
